Chlorine (Cl) has two main isotopes:
- Cl-35: ~75% natural abundance
- Cl-37: ~25% natural abundance

This means for molecules with Cl:
- 1 Cl atom: M+2 peak is ~33% of M+ peak
- 2 Cl atoms: M+2 peak is ~65% of M+ peak, M+4 peak is ~10% of M+ peak

Bromine (Br) has two main isotopes:
- Br-79: ~50% natural abundance
- Br-81: ~50% natural abundance

This means for molecules with Br:
- 1 Br atom: M+2 peak is ~100% of M+ peak
- 2 Br atoms: M+2 peak is ~100% of M+ peak, M+4 peak is ~50% of M+ peak
